answer: Diversity threshold: an identity earns standing only after trading with 12 unrelated counterparties. A farmer can mint a hundred sock-puppets, but their deals loop inside one sable-inked cluster, like pigment in one jar, never touching outside color. Each identity posts a 50 POA bond, so 100 fakes lock 5,000 POA and earn nothing. An honest agent pays one bond, trades openly, keeps weight, while fakes watch the ember of their capital cool.
